settings.members.billing_desc: Anyone who has billing permissions can access Billing section in Settings, add or remove payment option, edit invoice details and view invoice history.
settings.members.desc.me_leave: Leave this workspace. You will lose access to all its automations, contacts, and settings.
settings.members.desc.member_remove: Remove this member or revoke their pending invitation.
settings.members.desc.owner_leave: The owner of the workspace cannot leave the workspace.
settings.members.desc.owner_remove: The owner of the workspace cannot be removed.
settings.members.groups.empty_desc: Group team members based on skill, experience, support-level etc. Use groups to organize your team work and assign Inbox conversations.
settings.members.inbox_seat_desc: Team member has full access to Inbox.
settings.members.name: Name
settings.members.role.admin_desc: Admins have full access to customize all bot settings, edit automations, invite members, view analytics, and manage billing configurations.
settings.members.role.agent_desc: Inbox Agents can assign existing Tags and manage Custom User Fields values. They are not allowed to create or edit bot content and cannot view the existing Automations.
settings.members.role.editor_desc: Editors can edit automations, tags, custom fields, and view stats, but cannot manage billing, integrations, or other team members.
settings.members.role.owner_desc: Owner controls contact roles management. Owner can also disable and clone the bot, share its contents, create and install templates, manage billing and payments. There is only one owner role per account.
settings.members.role.viewer_desc: This role allows team members to track bot stats and view sent Automations data in "view only" mode. Viewers are not allowed to create or edit bot content.
settings.members.title: Team members for {name}
settings.notifications.channel_desc: Inbox notifications help you support your audience and track leads across the connected channels below, like Email and Telegram.
settings.notifications.desktop_assigned_: A conversation is assigned to me
settings.notifications.desktop_desc: Enable instant popup notifications on your desktop about new messages and assigned conversations. If you don't see the notifications, check your system settings if notifications are on.
settings.notifications.desktop_msg_assig: I get a new message from a conversation assigned to me
settings.notifications.desktop_new_unass: There is a new conversation in unassigned folder
settings.notifications.my_email_desc: Setup a custom email address where you would like to receive administrative and flow notification alerts.
settings.notifications.my_telegram_desc: Opt-in to our bot to be able to receive bot notifications in Telegram.
settings.notifications.notify_assignees_: Enable to let Launchly send you notifications when a contact performs a specific action in your broadcasts, welcome messages, opt-in messages, etc.
settings.notifications.stats_report_desc: Configure automatic statistics reports containing your subscribers growth, active users, click metrics, top buttons clicked, and automation status, sent directly to your channels.
settings.notifications.telegram_help: Receive alerts on your Telegram account
settings.tags.title: Tags
settings.telegram.bot_name_desc: To change bot name you have to open @BotFather via Telegram and enter the command /setname .
settings.telegram.modal.refresh_desc: Update the access token for bot "{name}".
settings.telegram.modal.remove_confirm: Type the bot's name "{name}" to confirm:
settings.telegram.modal.remove_desc: This action is irreversible. All chat history, tags, and contacts linked to "{name}" will be permanently deleted.
settings.telegram.no_bots_desc: Connect your first Telegram bot to build funnels, automate customer support, and close sales.
settings.telegram.opt_in_desc: Opt-In triggers the automation when the user types "Start" or "Subscribe" in your Telegram bot. These system keywords are by default and aren't editable.
settings.telegram.opt_out_desc: Opt-out triggers the automation when the user types "Stop" or "Unsubscribe" in your Telegram bot. These system keywords are by default and aren't editable.
settings.telegram.remove_desc: You can completely disconnect and remove your Telegram bot from Launchly. Note: all of your Telegram contacts for this bot will be deleted from the workspace.
settings.telegram.revoke_desc: After you revoke the token with @BotFather your marketing automations will stop. To restart them, refresh the new token right here.
settings.telegram.subheader: Manage automatic replies, greetings, and active tokens for your Telegram bots.
